description:
The Social Security Administration (SSA) Office of the Inspector General (OIG), Chicago Field Division, requires secure, continuously accessible indoor parking for Government-leased vehicles. The Contractor shall provide indoor parking spaces, access controls, facility security, and related parking services for authorized Government-leased vehicles. The Contractor shall make the required spaces available throughout the period of performance and provide: 
Reserved spaces: Three (3) spaces, assigned to SSA or designated users and marked or otherwise identified for their exclusive use; 
Unreserved spaces: Four (4) spaces, available to designated users on a first-come, first-served basis subject to availability and Garage capacity. 
This is a total small business set aside under NAICS 812930.
